other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the State Religious Minority Community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, or Jain).
Applicant must be a permanent resident of the State.
Family annual income must not exceed Rs.81,000 in rural areas or Rs.1,03,000 in urban areas.
No member of the applicant's family shall be an employee of the State/Central/Government PSU.
Applicants should not have availed of a loan in KMDC earlier.
benefits_summary: Subsidy of 33% of the unit cost up to a maximum of Rs. 1.00 lakh.
